documents.population: First-year applicants; additional requirements for international applicants (neither US citizen nor permanent resident, secondary school outside the US)
documents.notes: Caltech First-Year Application Requirements. Not drafted: the USD 85 application fee or fee waiver, mid-year report, International Financial Aid Statement of Intent (questions in the application), other optional supplemental materials (research paper). Unofficial transcripts may be uploaded; official ones are needed if admitted and enrolled.

items.quote: Application Common App or QuestBridge Application
Letters of Recommendation 1 STEM: Calculus (or beyond), Chemistry, Physics, or Biology 1 Humanities or Social Sciences
School Report: This is a document that your high school college counselor will send to Caltech that provides context about your school.
Official transcripts from your secondary school (grades 9-11, or the international curriculum equivalent).
We require either the SAT or ACT test scores.
Required of all international applicants unless 1) your native language is English or 2) English is the primary language of instruction in your secondary school.
items.condition: international applicant whose native language is not English and whose secondary school does not teach primarily in English

items.quote: If they were originally printed in a language other than English, we require the original document and an English translation.
items.condition: application materials originally in a language other than English
